title: SourceRef
description: Provenance reference pointing to evidence for a BrainCase memory record. SourceRef must not embed raw request bodies, raw prompts, or giant content blobs. It points to evidence; it does not store it.

source_ref_id.description: Unique identifier for this source reference.

summary.description: Brief description of what this source contains or established. Not the full raw content.

locator.description: Path, URL, issue number, commit hash, or other bounded locator for the source. Must not be a raw content dump.

content_hash.description: Optional hash of the referenced content at capture time.

captured_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this reference was captured. Null if unknown.

metadata.description: Optional bounded metadata key-value pairs. Must not store raw request bodies or prompt content.
